title: Task suite
description: A suite is a directory of task cases, each pairing a fixture reference with a task spec and the scoring probe used to grade it (ws-j item 3). fixer-worker suites seed faults into fixture repos and grade by re-running a seeded check; review-classifier suites pair thread payloads with expected verdicts from the toolkit's classifyThreads vocabulary.

name.description: The suite directory name under suites/<role>/.

role.description: The plan §9 role whose worker executes this suite's cases. Binding convention (a cross-object constraint role → cases[].probe.kind that JSON Schema cannot express; enforced by the J2 runner): fixer-worker suites use "check-rerun" probes; review-classifier suites use "expected-verdict" probes.

servedModel.description: The served model id cases in this suite are executed against (served-id decision 2026-09-14: the eval wires request the id the wire actually serves, e.g. glm-5.3-flash on the GLM coding wire).

provenance.description: Where the cases came from, for contamination transparency. Contamination posture: provenance is marked, and generated or mutated faults are preferred over verbatim public benchmark instances so scores measure fixing and classification skill rather than benchmark recall.

origin.description: How the suite was produced, e.g. "hand-seeded", "generated", "adapted".

reference.description: Named source the suite derives from or was inspired by, e.g. a public dataset name.

cases.description: The task cases in this suite. cases: [] is the empty-suite form; the runner emits an empty-but-valid table for it.

id.description: Case id, unique within the suite; enforcing uniqueness is the runner's job, not the schema's.

fixture.description: Repo-root-relative path to the fixture this case runs against — e.g. "fixtures/<name>" for a seeded-fault repo snapshot, or a thread payload file for review-classifier cases.

prompt.description: The task spec handed to the worker.

notes.description: Optional curator or runner notes about the task.

probe.description: Scoring probe, discriminated by `kind`: "check-rerun" re-runs a seeded check probe for scoring (reusing the toolkit's baselineProbe mechanics, sweep-agnostic); "expected-verdict" compares the classifier output against a verdict from the toolkit's exported classifyThreads vocabulary (actionable | responded | resolved | blocked | skip).

kind.description: Which scoring probe variant this case uses.

check.description: Repo-root-relative path to the seeded check probe to re-run for scoring (kind "check-rerun").

expected.description: Expected review-classifier verdict (kind "expected-verdict"), from the toolkit's exported classifyThreads vocabulary.
